comparison.objective: Remove a toy brick obstructing the robot’s own gripper and prove restored motion.
comparison.physical_skill: Self-recovery manipulation and gripper close-open functional testing.
comparison.success_condition: Obstruction removed and gripper closing and opening demonstrated; numeric motion thresholds are not in the indexed body.
comparison.reason: Both finish with functional motion verification, but this tests obstruction removal from the embodiment, not setting and locknut-retaining an angular stop.
